catalog.container_strategy: Preserve the entire source, examples, tests and notices; export include/testlib.h in an independent dev prefix. Build native checker, validator and deterministic-generator smoke examples during initialization. Transfer only admitted prebuilt executables to target.

installed_size.allocated_scope: Unique-inode st_blocks * 512 attribution; shared reflink extents are not deduplicated.
installed_size.scope: One quiescent filesystem tree including its root, no symlink traversal, hardlinks counted once; no OCI sharing or transient peak inferred.

native_probe.qualification_scope: Only the recorded commands and required files; complete feature, corpus and physical target qualification remain separate.

catalog.purpose: Prepare problem-specific input generators, validators and output checkers used by CodeContests+ and admitted contest corpora.
qualification_gaps: The declared example smoke does not qualify the full upstream compiler/standard matrix or every corpus problem.
Actual OCI and physical-target qualification remains independent.
catalog.size_basis: Actual complete source archive, all 521 upstream files and their summed logical bytes. Installed bytes are a separate native receipt, not an OCI layer estimate.
catalog.title: testlib C++ checkers, validators and generators

examples.description: Generate one integer in [1, 1000000]; the same complete argument list gives the same deterministic seed.
Validate one integer in [1, 100], one end-of-line and end-of-file; malformed data must fail.
Compare the contestant integer with the reference answer; output and reference are separate arguments.
Compile a task-specific checker against this exact header.
Run the unmodified native test-004 with its committed expected outputs and reference generation explicitly forbidden.

notes: The new source/binary package builds three unmodified upstream examples. Legacy selector installations retain the same header/source layout; their checks compile temporary examples when no new package-profile marker exists.
The original metadata.catalog, source identity and selector/target contract are retained. This resource does not impose data exposure policy on developers.

Selected regression qualification is GCC C++17 on Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64. The full upstream multi-compiler, multi-standard and Java-assisted runner is available in the retained source and is not claimed as executed.

Checker/validator return codes are tested using valid input, out-of-range input, missing EOLN, wrong answer, malformed output and malformed reference. A passing package check is not a qualification of every downstream problem-specific checker.
